descEnMap./map-calculator: Instant online Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP) calculator. Calculate organ perfusion pressure using MAP = DBP + 1/3(SBP - DBP) for sepsis, shock, and ICU resuscitation.
descEnMap./adjusted-body-weight: Calculate Ideal Body Weight (Devine formula) and Adjusted Body Weight for precise antibiotic and medication dosing in overweight and obese patients.
descEnMap./creatinine-clearance: Calculate creatinine clearance (CrCl) using the Cockcroft-Gault equation with actual or ideal body weight. Rapid renal function estimation for medication dosing.
descEnMap./pf-ratio: Calculate PaO2/FiO2 (Carrico index) from ABG to evaluate acute hypoxemic respiratory failure and classify ARDS severity by Berlin criteria.
descEnMap./steroid-conversion: Convert equipotent doses between Prednisone, Methylprednisolone, Dexamethasone, and Hydrocortisone with anti-inflammatory and mineralocorticoid potencies.
descEnMap./curb65-score: Calculate CURB-65 score to stratify mortality risk in community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) and determine outpatient vs inpatient vs ICU admission.
descEnMap./wells-score: Calculate Wells score for deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE). Clinical pre-test probability risk score with D-dimer decision guidance.
descEnMap./nutrition-must: Calculate MUST score for malnutrition risk screening based on BMI, unintended weight loss, and acute disease effect according to ESPEN guidelines.
